title: Euler: Integer Partitions Modulo M (Pentagonal Theorem)
prompt: Implement `partition_mod(n: int, mod: int) -> int` in `solution.py` in the current working directory. It must return p(n) % mod, where p(n) is the number of integer partitions of n (p(0) = 1). Your implementation MUST handle n = 50_000 in under 4 seconds in pure Python (hint: O(n^2) DP will be too slow; consider Euler's pentagonal number theorem). Verify with `python -m unittest test_basic.py` and benchmark n = 50_000. Do NOT modify `test_basic.py` and stop once verified.
